summary: Sonarr is a self-hosted television series manager that coordinates downloads through Usenet and BitTorrent clients. It automates the retrieval, sorting, and renaming of new episodes, and can automatically replace existing files when higher-quality formats appear.
goodFor: It is suited for users who want to automate their television media libraries and maintain consistent file organisation across storage volumes.
watchOut: You will need to run and maintain compatible download clients separately, as this application handles organisation rather than direct protocol transfers.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves setting up persistent storage volumes for your media library and configuration data, alongside a reverse proxy if you require external TLS access.
